scripts.aspire:require-cli: node -e "const { spawnSync } = require('node:child_process'); const result = spawnSync('aspire', ['--version'], { stdio: 'ignore' }); if (result.error || result.status !== 0) { console.error('Aspire CLI is required. Run aspire update --self --channel staging --yes --non-interactive.'); process.exit(1); }"
scripts.aspire:restore: npm run aspire:require-cli && aspire restore --apphost apphost.mts --non-interactive
scripts.aspire:start: npm run aspire:require-cli && aspire run --apphost apphost.mts
scripts.build:web-if-ready: node -e "const { existsSync } = require('node:fs'); const { spawnSync } = require('node:child_process'); if (!existsSync('apps/web/src')) { console.log('Skipping @adamratzman/web build until apps/web sources move into the workspace'); process.exit(0); } const npmExecPath = process.env.npm_execpath; if (!npmExecPath) { console.error('npm_execpath is not set; unable to run the web workspace build.'); process.exit(1); } const result = spawnSync(process.execPath, [npmExecPath, 'run', 'build', '--workspace', '@adamratzman/web'], { stdio: 'inherit' }); if (result.error) { console.error(result.error); process.exit(1); } if (result.signal) { console.error('Web workspace build terminated with signal', result.signal); process.exit(1); } process.exit(result.status ?? 1);"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @adamratzman/contracts --if-present && npm run build --workspace @adamratzman/api --if-present && npm run build:web-if-ready && npm run aspire:build
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present && npm run aspire:build
scripts.lint: npm run aspire:lint && eslint --no-error-on-unmatched-pattern apps/web/src apps/web/test services/api/src services/api/test packages/contracts/src packages/contracts/test tests/e2e
